name: Sports
description: Olympics, cricket and Indian sports legends.

questions.question: Which city hosted the 2024 Summer Olympics?
questions.explanation: Paris 2024 (26 July – 11 August 2024) was the third Paris Games; Los Angeles hosts the 2028 edition.

questions.question: How many medals did India win at the Paris 2024 Olympics?
questions.explanation: India won six medals at Paris 2024: Neeraj Chopra's silver plus five bronze (Manu Bhaker ×2, hockey team, Aman Sehrawat, Swapnil Kusale).

questions.question: Neeraj Chopra won the javelin silver at Paris 2024 with a throw of what distance?
questions.explanation: Neeraj's 89.45 m earned silver behind Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem (92.97 m, Olympic record) — his second straight Olympic medal.

questions.question: Who became the first Indian woman shooter to win Olympic medals — two bronzes at Paris 2024?
questions.explanation: Manu Bhaker won bronze in the 10 m air pistol (individual) and mixed team with Sarabjot Singh at Paris 2024.

questions.question: Which chess player was among the Khel Ratna awardees for 2024?
questions.explanation: The 2024 Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna went to D. Gukesh, Manu Bhaker, Harmanpreet Singh and para-athlete Praveen Kumar (awarded January 2025).

questions.question: Who became the youngest undisputed World Chess Champion in December 2024?
questions.explanation: Gukesh (18) beat defending champion Ding Liren to become the youngest world champion, surpassing Garry Kasparov's 1985 record.

questions.question: National Sports Day (29 August) marks the birth anniversary of which hockey legend?
questions.explanation: Major Dhyan Chand, born 29 August 1905, won three Olympic golds (1928, 1932, 1936); the Khel Ratna is named after him.

questions.question: Who holds the record for most centuries in Test cricket?
questions.explanation: Sachin Tendulkar's 51 Test hundreds remain the record; he also holds the record for most international runs and centuries overall.

questions.question: India has won the ICC Men's ODI World Cup in which years?
questions.explanation: Kapil Dev's team won in 1983 at Lord's; M. S. Dhoni's team won in 2011 at Mumbai. India also won T20 WCs in 2007, 2024 and 2026.

questions.question: Who won the 2025 World Test Championship final at Lord's?
questions.explanation: Australia beat South Africa at Lord's in June 2025 to claim their maiden WTC mace — the third WTC edition.

questions.question: Who was the first Indian to win the All England Open Badminton title (1980)?
questions.explanation: Prakash Padukone won the All England in 1980; Gopichand became the second Indian to win it, in 2001.

questions.question: P. V. Sindhu won an Olympic silver at Rio 2016 — the first Indian woman to do so in which sport?
questions.explanation: Sindhu's Rio 2016 silver made her the first Indian woman to win an Olympic silver medal (badminton).

questions.question: Which Indian sprinter is famously known as the 'Flying Sikh'?
questions.explanation: Milkha Singh earned the nickname after his exploits at the 1960 Rome Olympics, where he missed a 400 m medal by a whisker.

questions.question: Which hockey legend is known as 'The Wizard'?
questions.explanation: Major Dhyan Chand's stick-work earned him 'The Wizard' moniker; he scored 400+ international goals.

questions.question: How many amateur world boxing championships has Mary Kom won?
questions.explanation: M. C. Mary Kom won a record six world titles (2002–2018) plus an Olympic bronze at London 2012.
